WITH sales_daily AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        DateKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS total_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales
    GROUP BY
        StoreKey,
        DateKey
),
outage_daily AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        DateKey,
        sum(ifNull(DownTime, 0)) AS total_downtime
    FROM retail.FactITSLA
    GROUP BY
        StoreKey,
        DateKey
)
SELECT corr(ifNull(o.total_downtime, 0), ifNull(s.total_sales, 0)) AS outage_sales_correlation
FROM sales_daily AS s
FULL OUTER JOIN outage_daily AS o
    ON s.StoreKey = o.StoreKey
   AND s.DateKey = o.DateKey
